title: Power of Two
statement: Return true when `n` is a power of two. 1 is 2^0 and counts. Non-positive numbers do not.
hints: A power of two has exactly one bit set.
For n > 0, n & (n - 1) is 0 exactly then.
n > 0 is required because zero and negatives are not powers of two.
editorial: Powers of two are 1, 2, 4, 8, and so on. In binary each is a single 1 followed by zeros. Clearing the lowest set bit of such a number produces 0. Any other positive number still has a bit left.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def is_power_of_two(n: int) -> bool:
    return n > 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0
